slides.title: Why crewing offices *skip* your CV
slides.sub: Fix these 4 things before your next application.

slides.title: Lead with your rank
slides.body: First line: your rank, the vessel types you've sailed and the date you can join. That's what recruiters search for.

slides.title: Show every expiry date
slides.body: List each certificate with its expiry date. Hidden dates make a recruiter check everything twice.

slides.title: Sea service as a clean table
slides.body: Vessel type, rank, sign-on, sign-off, months. One row per contract, newest first.

slides.title: Use their *portal* if they have one
slides.body: Some agencies only review applications made on their own portal. A CV emailed to their inbox may never be opened.

slides.a: A longer CV looks more experienced.
slides.b: Recruiters scan. Rank, vessel type and valid certificates get you the call.

slides.question: What's the first line on your CV?
slides.line: Ocean Link builds your CV from your sea time in one tap.
